info.title: Flare API
info.description: Flare is a sovereign, self-hostable observability backend (errors, logs, traces). Send data with any Sentry SDK (change only the DSN) or over OTLP; manage projects, issues, releases and source maps with an org API key.

post.description: The endpoint modern @sentry/* SDKs post to. Point an SDK at Flare by changing only the DSN host; no code changes. Accepts the Sentry envelope format (newline-delimited JSON). Supported items commit in one transaction; a store failure rolls them back and returns 503. Exact item replays within hot-tier retention are deduplicated. A reused item ID with different payload bytes returns 409.

parameters.description: The numeric project id from the DSN.

post.summary: Create an API key (plaintext shown once)
post.description: role selects what the key may do and defaults to viewer (read-only). member adds writes, including DELETE /api/projects/{id}, which erases a project and all of its telemetry. owner and admin are not mintable as keys: team management and SSO configuration stay interactive.

post.description: DSN-authenticated, payload-free health receipt for a SaaS or app connector. Flare supplies tenant/project scope and timestamps and acknowledges only after the connector attempt is stored. The result is client_reported and cannot claim a registered provider connection.

A confidential business key determines tenant and project. The public browser/Flutter DSN cannot authorize this endpoint. Flare derives the completion time, writes a payload-free business check and accepted ingest receipt in one transaction, and returns the receipt ID only after commit. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key after a timeout or lost response: an identical normalized assertion returns the same receipt. Authenticated non-202 responses increment business-key usage errors; a 401 after a concurrent revocation also increments denied. Pre-auth failures and rate limits have no tenant usage attribution.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque per-operation token; reuse on retries. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

202.description: Business result and receipt committed; Idempotency-Replayed is true on an identical retry

Idempotency-Replayed.description: true when this key returned an existing accepted receipt

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, revoked, or wrong-project business key

409.description: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different normalized assertion

429.description: Per-IP or per-key ingest rate limit reached; no tenant usage attribution

connection_id.description: Opaque registered installation ID; empty/omitted for legacy or external DSN receipts.

get.description: Returns tenant-scoped worker state, lease status, cursor presence/version, and bounded completion metadata. Cursor material, credentials, provider payloads, and tenant identifiers are never returned.

get.description: Returns project and tenant scoped counts, error rate, latency aggregates, and last observation times. No request payload or user data is returned.

Request bodies, credentials, user IDs, and provider payloads are never returned.

post.description: Atomically leases one tenant-scoped stage and target revision to an external worker. The claim id is opaque and grants no repository, CI, deployment, or probe capability. A passed execution receipt must include the active claim id.

evidence_ref.description: Required for patch claims and must be the lowercase AI evidence digest

409.description: Stage is not eligible or is already claimed

get.summary: Query the next eligible fix-to-deploy workflow stage
get.description: Read-only, tenant-scoped handoff for an external coding-loop worker. It returns bounded stage metadata only; Flare never executes the returned action or dereferences evidence.

200.description: Bounded next-stage state (ready, pending, verification_pending, retry, blocked, complete, or not_started); external passes require trusted Stage verification

get.summary: Count caller-reported execution passes awaiting trusted verification
get.description: Authenticated project-scoped counts for unverified passed CI, merge, deploy, and synthetic receipts created in the past 30 days. Counts grant no execution authority.

200.description: State clear or pending, fixed 720-hour window, total and per-stage counts

404.description: Project not found in caller organization

200.description: Bounded triage, patch, CI, deploy, rollback, and synthetic receipts; each row includes server-owned verification_status

post.description: Passed patch, CI, merge, deploy, and synthetic receipts must follow the same target revision in order. External passed CI, merge, deploy, and synthetic receipts remain unverified advisory reports until trusted Stage attestation; opaque run_ref or evidence_ref values cannot advance workflow or accepted-deploy monitoring. A passed patch requires evidence_ref to be the 64-character lowercase SHA-256 digest from a completed fresh AI triage receipt for the same issue. Review approval requires a human session actor; execution passes require run_ref. A passed synthetic receipt additionally requires evidence_ref for the observed canary or probe result. Rollback receipts require source_revision and target_revision, and a passed rollback requires run_ref. Failed or blocked stages may be recorded without a predecessor; rollback is never inferred from deploy receipts.

claim_id.description: Required for passed patch, CI, merge, deploy, and synthetic receipts; obtained from automation-claims

evidence_ref.description: required for passed patch receipts as a 64-character lowercase AI evidence digest; required for passed synthetic receipts as an opaque canary or probe result reference

source_revision.description: required for rollback receipts; revision being removed

target_revision.description: required for approved review and passed patch/CI/merge/deploy/rollback/synthetic stages

get.description: Returns release-scoped metadata and digests only; raw symbol bytes are never returned.

post.description: Stores one bounded base64-wrapped Dart symbols, ProGuard, Breakpad, dSYM, or ELF artifact. Flutter Dart symbols receive a bounded container validation at upload; the response includes the durable validation_status. Upload acceptance does not claim frame symbolication.

content_base64.description: base64 encoded artifact, decoded size <= 30 MiB

get.description: Returns bounded artifact metadata with an explicit retained_unresolved status. Symbol bytes and inferred frame locations are never returned.

get.summary: Query latest connector quota, rate-limit, and sync-lag hints
get.description: Returns bounded, payload-free provider metadata grouped by connector series. Values are omitted when the provider did not report that hint. Sync lag is explicitly reported by the bridge after a completed sync/read; it is not inferred from silence.

200.description: Bounded latest quota, retry-after, and sync-lag aggregates

connection_id.description: Opaque registered installation ID; omitted for legacy external receipts

get.summary: Query project connector quota, rate-limit, and sync-lag hints
get.description: Returns the same bounded connector hint projection as the organization route after verifying that the caller's organization owns the project.

200.description: Bounded project latest quota, retry-after, and sync-lag aggregates

connection_id.description: Opaque registered installation ID; omitted for legacy external receipts

get.description: Returns tenant-scoped provider and installation metadata only. Credentials and encrypted ciphertext are never returned.

secret.description: Encrypted with FLARE_SECRET_KEY before storage; never returned.

project_id.description: Required when registering an active HubSpot installation; must belong to the caller's workspace.

post.description: An active HubSpot installation requires a tenant-owned project_id so its server-observed checks and sync state can drive that project's health and alerts. Historical org-only installations can be assigned later with PATCH.

patch.summary: Update connector connection metadata or rotate its credential (admin)
patch.description: Omit secret to preserve the encrypted credential. Supplying a secret replaces it; the response remains metadata-only. Set project_id once to assign a historical org-only installation; provider, installation_id, and an existing project binding are immutable.

project_id.description: One-time project binding for an unbound installation; cannot be cleared or changed.

post.summary: Run a bounded connector health check (admin)
post.description: Runs one fixed-authority adapter: HubSpot account metadata, GitHub user, Slack auth.test, or OpenAI models. Provider response bodies and credentials are discarded; the result contains bounded status and rate-limit hints and emits a tenant-scoped connector attempt.

operation.description: account_details for HubSpot, user for GitHub, auth.test for Slack, or models for OpenAI

receipt_status.description: Whether Flare durably persisted the payload-free connector receipt; independent of provider outcome.

422.description: Provider is not supported by the bounded probe

post.summary: Run one bounded connector synchronization pass (admin)
post.description: Claims a short tenant-scoped lease and runs the HubSpot account-details adapter. The provider body and credential are discarded; no background polling is started by this endpoint.

receipt_status.description: Present when a provider call was made; whether Flare persisted its connector receipt, independently of provider outcome.

202.description: Another worker owns the lease; no provider call was made

409.description: Connection is paused, revoked, or otherwise disabled

422.description: Provider is not supported by the bounded worker

get.description: Admin session only. Returns at most 100 keys, with every active key first, without bearer secrets or hashes.

200.description: Bounded key metadata, including revoked keys

404.description: Project not found in this organization

post.summary: Provision one confidential project business key
post.description: Admin session with CSRF only. Shows the random 192-bit bearer secret once. Up to eight active unexpired keys are allowed per project; keep a spare slot to create a replacement before revoking an old key. Action is audited.

201.description: Created; key is shown once and never returned by list

409.description: Active business key limit reached; revoke an unused key

404.description: Project not found in this organization

404.description: Project or active key not found in this organization

get.description: Returns the same bounded state projection as the org route, restricted to installations explicitly bound to this project. Historical unbound installations appear only in the org route.

apiKey.description: Org-scoped API key (Bearer). Create one in Settings. Acts at member level: manage projects, issues, releases, source maps; not team admin.
